inputs.description: random_select_feature_sets() and smd_select_feature_sets() at target_size 0-3 (boolean) / 0-2 (xor), seed reset to 1 immediately before each call (matching a fresh -r 1 process); incremental_select_feature_sets() for seven target_size/threshold/inc_interaction_terms combinations on both tables (fully deterministic, no RNG); smd_select_feature_sets() with scorer='pre' (pre_scorer, moses_matrix.h) at two target_sizes, with the four otherwise-uninitialized pre_* fields set to their real CLI defaults. 'hc' (algo/deme_optimize.{h,cc}) is deliberately NOT captured -- classic's own --algo hc path segfaults unconditionally, confirmed against the real installed binary and a gdb backtrace (hill_climbing::operator() dereferences a null iscorer.get_rep() in an unconditional debug-log line, hill-climbing.cc:69) -- see fs_standalone_probe.cc's own header comment.
